attempts.rationale: The private repo makes 'read' depend on a collaborator role. A's revoke route removes the subject's role, and A's per-request evaluation denies the subject's next request (404). B caches the role per session, so the subject's same session still sees the cached 'admin' role and gets 200, violating per-request freshness. If A's revoke did nothing, the second request would also return 200 and the probe would fail. In base and B the revoke route is absent, so the DELETE is Hono's default 404 text/plain and the probe reports n/a.
